title: What is my superpower? Free superpower quiz — cv.cm
description: Free superpower quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if your power is flight, invisibility, telepathy, time travel, teleportation, super strength, healing or shapeshifting. No sign-up.
lede: Would you fly, read minds or turn back time? Answer 12 questions about how you think, help and escape to find the superpower that fits your personality.
about: "Which superpower would you choose?" is a classic question because the answer says something about you: people who pick flight often crave freedom, people who pick invisibility value privacy, and people who pick healing want to help. This quiz turns that idea around. Instead of asking you to choose, it asks how you live and matches you with the power that suits you.

Your result names your superpower, explains how it matches your personality and shows your scores for all eight. It's a fun quiz written for cv.cm, not a scientific test, and no comic-book characters are involved. If you enjoy it, try the mythical creature and Avengers quizzes on this site.

faq.a: Flight, invisibility, telepathy, time travel, teleportation, super strength, healing and shapeshifting.

faq.q: Is one power rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every superpower appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Can I get more than one?
faq.a: Your result is the power you scored highest on, but the chart shows all eight, so you can see your runner-up too.
No. It's just for fun, and your answers stay in your browser.

items.q: A free day with no plans. You…
options: Go somewhere with a big open view
Enjoy being where nobody can bother you
Have long, deep talks with friends
Visit a museum or read about history
Keep everyone's spirits up and fix arguments
Run between everyone to get things done
Know what people mean before they say it
Something I'd like to do over
A time I couldn't protect someone
Speaking up when I should have stayed quiet
Actor: a new person every role

items.q: Your friends rely on you for…
options: Doing the heavy lifting, literally and not
Showing up the moment they need you

items.q: When things get tough you want to…
options: Change into whoever the moment needs
Skip ahead to when it's solved
Knowing more than people think I do
As many cities as possible in one trip

items.q: You find a mysterious door. You…
options: Check that everyone is safe first
Wonder who opened it before you
Ask the others what they're thinking
Solving a mystery nobody knew I was working on
Preventing a disaster before it happens
Saving someone everyone else had given up on

flight.name: Flight
flight.body: You crave freedom, space and the big picture. You don't like feeling trapped, you dream big and you see possibilities others miss from ground level. Flight suits someone who lifts other people's eyes to the horizon.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.body: You are observant, private and quietly clever. You notice everything, you don't need the spotlight and you often know more than you let on. Invisibility suits someone who works best behind the scenes.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.body: You are empathetic and perceptive, and you read people well. Friends feel understood around you, often before they've said much. Telepathy suits someone whose real strength is connection.

timetravel.name: Time travel
timetravel.body: You are thoughtful, curious and a little nostalgic. You love stories, history and imagining how things could have gone. Time travel suits someone who learns from the past and plans for the future.

teleport.name: Teleportation
teleport.body: You are fast, energetic and hate wasting time. You want to be everywhere, help everyone and see everything. Teleportation suits someone who always shows up when it matters.

strength.name: Super strength
strength.body: You are determined, protective and reliable. You take on the heavy jobs and you don't give up when things get hard. Super strength suits someone others lean on, so make sure you lean on them too sometimes.

healing.name: Healing
healing.body: You are caring, calm and generous. You can't stand to see people hurting and you're the first to help. Healing suits someone who makes the world gentler. Remember to heal yourself too.

shapeshift.name: Shapeshifting
shapeshift.body: You are adaptable, creative and hard to pin down. You fit into any group, try on new ideas easily and never want to be just one thing. Shapeshifting suits someone who keeps reinventing themselves.
